Name: Quotes
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod installed, a quote is selected each day and displayed just before the screen fades in when you wake up. By default it shows a specific quote for each day of the year, and the quote fades away after either clicking a button or waiting a certain period of time based on the number of lines in the day's quote.

The mod comes with a set of 112 eclectic quotes for each day of the Stardew Valley year that I thought were insightful and somewhat relevant to my own feelings about Stardew Valley (some actually relate to the change in seasons too). They are located in the mod's [b]assets[/b] folder as [b]quotes_default.txt[/b]. To use your own set of quotations, create a file called [b]quotes.txt[/b] in the mod's [b]assets[/b] folder and it will ignore mine.

You can also feel free to publish your own set of quotes as a separate mod, just tell people to install this mod and put your quotes.txt file in this mod's assets folder.

Quotation files must be one quote per line, in the format [b]quote^author[/b] (i.e. quote and author are separated by a caret [b]^[/b]). For example:

[b]Nothing is impossible, the word itself says 'I'm possible'!^Audrey Hepburn[/b]

You can customize the quote display to a certain extent by editing the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file variables:

[list]
[*]"[b]EnableMod[/b]": true, - set to false to disable the mod
[*]"[b]QuoteColor[/b]": "143, 188, 139, 255", - a color code in RGBA 0-255 notation
[*]"[b]QuoteCharPerLine[/b]": 50, - characters per line (approximate)
[*]"[b]QuoteDurationPerLineMult[/b]": 1.0, - increase this number to make the quotes last longer (set to a negative value to make the quote last until you click)
[*]"[b]QuoteFadeMult[/b]": 1, - increase this number to make the fade in happen more quickly
[*]"[b]AuthorPrefix[/b]": "-- ", - a string of characters with which to prefix the author name
[*]"[b]ClickToDispelQuote[/b]": true  - if true, clicking any button or key causes the fade to begin﻿
[*]"[b]RandomQuote": false[/b] - if true, the daily quote will be selected at random.
[*]"[b]QuoteWidth[/b]": 1000 - how many pixels wide the quote can be at maximum.
[*]"[b]LineSpacing[/b]": 10 - extra pixels between each line of text.
[/list]
This mod now has an app for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523/]Mobile Phone[/url]﻿ which will show up if you have that mod installed.[list]
[b][/b][/list][b]
[size=4]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. Doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
